_comment: Teaching content for this game's notes page. make-notes.py builds pedagogical-notes.html from this and README.md. 'by' says whose idea it is (todd or claude); it is never shown on the page.
now: A field journal records one true fact about each of the 24 species you document, across the four layers of the rainforest (floor, understory, canopy, emergent), by night and by day.

considering.text: A sketch of each animal in the journal.
Hints about which layer of the forest an animal lives in.
